description: Dataset - Polish mobility patterns is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Agnieszka Szmelter-Jarosz. Dataset in Polish about the mobility choices of residents of urban, suburban and rural areas (random sample, n=2000), October 2019. Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1424475 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
